title: Chicken Satay Crunch Bowl
description: Ginger chicken, crisp vegetables and rice with a lighter chilli-peanut dressing.
ingredients: Lime, ginger and chilli to taste
steps: Cook the rice, then spread it out briefly to cool.
Sear ginger-seasoned chicken until golden and cooked through.
Whisk the dressing ingredients with warm water and toss through the assembled bowl.

source.label: Adapted from Good Food chicken satay salad

notes: Raw, crunchy veg adds volume and micronutrients with almost no extra calories — useful when cutting but still hungry.
